$comment: Figures that go stale when laws, budgets or prices change. scripts/check-data-reviews.mjs reads this at the start of every Claude Code session (SessionStart hook in .claude/settings.json) and flags any entry past its `due` date or not checked for a year. After checking, run `pnpm data:reviewed <id> <next-due YYYY-MM-DD>`.

reviews.what: Income tax bands and rates (rUK and Scotland), personal allowance taper, National Insurance, student loan thresholds, tax years offered
files: lib/tools.ts (SEO titles name the tax year)
reviews.when: After each UK Budget and Scottish Budget; add the new tax year before 6 April

reviews.what: Dividend allowance and rates, corporation tax rates and marginal relief, Class 4 NI, umbrella/Ltd assumptions
reviews.when: After each UK Budget; new rates usually start 6 April (dividends, NI) or 1 April (corporation tax)

reviews.what: SDLT, LBTT (and ADS) and LTT bands, first-time buyer relief, surcharges
reviews.when: After each UK Budget (next 28 Oct 2026), Scottish Budget and Welsh Budget; changes can start the day after

reviews.what: New Style JSA weekly rates and Universal Credit savings limits used by the emergency fund calculator
reviews.when: Benefit rates are uprated every April; the new rates are announced in the autumn

reviews.what: ONS CPI and long-run RPI indices; run `pnpm data:inflation` and check the diff and the guide's numbers
reviews.when: Once a year after December's figures come out in mid January (completes the previous year's average); any month for a fresher latest figure

reviews.what: Default prices and rates that follow the market, not the law: mortgage rates, car finance APRs and lease quote, garden material, raised bed timber and lawn seed, turf, feed and water prices, patio slab, MOT, sand, cement and jointing compound prices, contractor umbrella fees and costs
Metered water + sewerage price per m³ (default and the Thames / United Utilities range quoted in hints and guides)
reviews.when: Water companies set new charges every 1 April (announced in February); Ofwat charging rules may change from April 2027

reviews.what: Ofgem price cap unit rate, Smart Export Guarantee rates, EV tariff off-peak rates and windows, typical solar and battery install costs, Ofgem typical consumption values, DESNZ grid carbon factor, VAT relief end date
files: lib/solar.ts (DEFAULT_IMPORT, DEFAULT_EXPORT, DEFAULT_OFF_PEAK, OFF_PEAK_DAY_RATE, solarCostFor, batteryCostFor, USE_PRESETS, GRID_CO2)
components/tools/solar-payback-calculator.tsx (hints quote the cap and VAT date)
reviews.when: The cap changes every quarter (1 Jan, 1 Apr, 1 Jul, 1 Oct; the next is announced 25 Nov 2026); VAT relief on installs ends 31 Mar 2027
